name: Victoria
source: Victoria is a dedicated worker. She owns the Solvalley bar where young people can work as a waiter to make money. Endowed with exotic beauty, Victoria had to get used to the frequent harassment she receives from her bar patrons. For always rejecting the attempts, she gained the reputation of being a lesbian.
